retrievalProfile.description: A centered, symmetrical geometric diagram of overlapping white circles containing vibrant, glowing planetary bodies against a grainy dark-to-blue gradient background.
triggerTerms: glowing spheres in white line art
excludeWhen: chaotic or asymmetrical compositions are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central large circle containing a complex arrangement of five smaller overlapping circles. Each intersection and void houses a unique, glowing celestial object—ranging from gaseous planets to crystalline cubes—rendered with high saturation and internal luminescence. The entire structure is set against a vertical gradient transitioning from deep black at the top to a textured royal blue at the bottom, featuring a subtle film grain throughout.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical white line-art geometry containing vibrant organic forms
High-contrast relationship between thin white strokes and dark background
Internal glow of planets contrasting with the matte grainy texture of the void
Vertical hierarchy of symbols and text along the left margin
coreInvariants: Uniform thin white stroke for all geometric circles
Heavy film grain or noise texture overlay
Vibrant, neon-like saturation for the planetary bodies

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The geometric diagram is perfectly centered, occupying approximately 70% of the frame's height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A bright yellow-orange sun-like sphere at the dead center of the diagram.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central sun, moves outward along the circular paths to the surrounding planets, then travels to the vertical text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive dark space around the central diagram, emphasizing its isolation and importance.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep midnight blue to black gradient (Background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white (Geometric lines and marginal text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multi-colored neon (Planetary bodies: magenta, cyan, lime, orange)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, high-saturation accents against a low-value, low-saturation background.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high purity in the neon accents

letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for a spacious, airy feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a clean, modern sans-serif and a classic, elegant italicized serif.
graphicDevices: Abstract celestial icons (stars, infinity, atoms) stacked vertically

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric clarity for the sans-serif role
Elegant contrast for the subtitle role

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical gradient from black to deep blue with a heavy film grain texture. Center a white line-art diagram of overlapping circles. Inside the circles, place various glowing, high-saturation planets and cosmic objects.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical text along the left margin using a white geometric sans-serif for the bottom and a white italic serif for the middle. Include a stack of small white celestial icons at the top left.

verificationChecks: Is the central diagram perfectly symmetrical?
Are the planetary bodies glowing and highly saturated?
Is the text oriented vertically along the left edge?
Is there a visible grain or noise texture across the image?

adjustableVariables: Number and type of celestial objects

mustAchieve: Smooth color transitions in the planets

postGenerationChecks: Check for perfect centering of the main circle
Ensure the white lines are consistent in thickness
Verify the vertical alignment of the marginal text and icons
Confirm the grain texture is uniform and not blotchy
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical white geometry + glowing neon celestial bodies + grainy dark gradient + vertical marginal typography.
